answer: Bind each agent key to a distinct postal address. At registration the protocol mails a sable card with a one-time code; the key earns only after its operator returns that code, and the check repeats at random intervals. Keys whose mail lands at the same address or forwarding box merge into one reward share. A farm of 1,000 clones must rent 1,000 real mailboxes for months, a cost no fast quill can bridge, since each box needs its own lease and its own steady hand to read it.
